description: Full v0.2.0 code implementation: fix the blocking tsconfig error, then add error collection end-to-end (type, redaction utils, storage, interceptor, core wiring, ErrorsTab, provider, modal registration, Overview rows), upgrade JSONViewer syntax highlighting, enrich ContextEngine, upgrade AITab, and update exports. This is one coherent unit — every step builds on earlier ones (types -> utils -> storage -> interceptors -> core -> UI/provider/modal -> AI -> exports) and the whole feature must leave `npx tsc --noEmit` at exit 0. Docs are intentionally deferred to FEAT-002, which depends on this feature's final API surface.
steps: FIX FIRST: In tsconfig.json change `"moduleResolution": "bundler"` to `"moduleResolution": "node"` (keep module: commonjs). On a clean checkout `npx tsc --noEmit` fails with TS5095 until this is done; the existing source otherwise compiles clean. Run tsc to confirm exit 0 before continuing.

Create src/types/ErrorTypes.ts exporting interface AppError { id: string; message: string; stack?: string; timestamp: number; isFatal: boolean }. (Verified no existing error type in src/types/ — NetworkTypes/LogTypes/EventTypes/AITypes only.)

Create src/utils/redact.ts with: redactHeaders(headers: Record<string, unknown>, sensitiveKeys: string[]): Record<string, unknown> — build a new object, for each key replace value with '[REDACTED]' when key.toLowerCase() matches any sensitiveKeys entry lowercased, never mutate input; and redactFields(obj: unknown, sensitiveFields: string[]): unknown — recursively walk arrays and plain objects, redacting values whose key matches case-insensitively, returning primitives unchanged, with cycle protection (WeakSet).

In src/storage/AppLensStorage.ts add three SYNCHRONOUS methods to the interface: addError(error: AppError): void; getErrors(query?: { limit?: number }): AppError[]; clearErrors(): void. Import AppError from ../types/ErrorTypes.

In src/storage/MemoryStorage.ts implement the three methods: add a private readonly errors: AppError[] = [] and a maxErrorEntries field (new 4th constructor param, default 200). addError uses pushRingBuffer then notify(); getErrors returns a copy, and when query.limit is set returns the most-recent `limit` items; clearErrors sets length=0 and notify(). Leave the existing Set<()=>void> subscribe/notify as-is (already correct).

Create src/interceptors/ErrorInterceptor.ts: class with constructor(storage: AppLensStorage), attach(), detach(), guarded by an `attached` boolean (mirror ConsoleInterceptor). attach() saves ErrorUtils.getGlobalHandler() and installs ErrorUtils.setGlobalHandler((error: Error, isFatal?: boolean) => { storage.addError({ id: generateId(), message: error?.message ?? String(error), stack: error?.stack, timestamp: Date.now(), isFatal: !!isFatal }); saved?.(error, isFatal); }). Also feature-detect global.HermesInternal?.enablePromiseRejectionTracker and register a tracker that stores rejections as non-fatal AppError (fall back to no-op when unavailable). detach() restores the saved handler and disables the rejection tracker. Declare minimal local ambient types for ErrorUtils and HermesInternal (no new deps). Reuse the generateId inline pattern.

In src/interceptors/NetworkInterceptor.ts remove the local redactHeaders function and import redactHeaders from ../utils/redact; at each call site cast the result back to Record<string, string> so the NetworkRequest header fields stay typed. Behaviour must be identical.

In src/core/AppLensConfig.ts add (keep ALL existing fields): errors: boolean (default true), persistLogs?: boolean (default false), verboseLogging?: boolean (default false), redaction?: { headers?: string[]; fields?: string[] } (default undefined). Update DEFAULT_CONFIG accordingly.

In src/core/AppLens.ts: add private errorInterceptor: ErrorInterceptor | null = null; add getVersion(): string returning '0.2.0'; in startInterceptors() and attachInterceptors() create+attach ErrorInterceptor when config.errors !== false and detach otherwise (mirror network/console); extend detachInterceptors() to also detach the error interceptor; add reset(): void that detaches all interceptors, clears all storage (clearNetworkRequests/clearLogs/clearEvents/clearErrors) and sets this.initialized=false. Pass maxErrorEntries to the MemoryStorage constructor (use its default).

In src/core/AppLensProvider.tsx add 'Errors' to the TabName union, add errors state (useState<AppError[]>([])), update the sync callback to setErrors([...storage.getErrors()]), and add errors to the context value interface, the value object, and the useMemo dependency array. Import AppError.

Create src/tabs/ErrorsTab.tsx modeled on EventsTab.tsx (dark theme #0d0d0d/#1a1a1a, accent #00ff88): header with error count + Clear button calling AppLens.getStorage().clearErrors(); a SearchBar filtering by message; FlatList<AppError> with keyExtractor returning item.id and a ListEmptyComponent; each row a TouchableOpacity with accessibilityRole='button' showing timestamp, message, and an isFatal Badge (red when fatal); tapping expands a detail area with the full stack in a horizontal ScrollView. Read the error list from useAppLens().errors.

In src/components/AppLensModal.tsx import ErrorsTab, insert 'Errors' into TABS between 'Events' and 'AI' (7 tabs total), add case 'Errors': return <ErrorsTab /> to TabContent, add accessibilityRole='button' to each tab TouchableOpacity and the close button. Leave the already-horizontal ScrollView tab bar as-is.

In src/tabs/OverviewTab.tsx read errors from useAppLens(), compute total + fatal counts, add an Errors stat/row showing both, and add an 'AppLens' version row showing AppLens.getVersion(). Keep existing dark styling and Badge usage.

Rewrite src/components/JSONViewer.tsx to render pretty-printed JSON as inline Text spans with distinct dark-theme colors (keys / string values / numbers-booleans-null) and wrap in a ScrollView that scrolls both vertically (respecting the existing maxHeight prop) and horizontally. Keep JSONViewerProps ({ data, maxHeight? }) unchanged so ConsoleTab/EventsTab/NetworkDetailScreen keep compiling.

In src/ai/ContextEngine.ts add buildErrorChunks() that reads storage.getErrors() (recent first) and formats each as '[ERROR] ${e.message}\n${e.stack ?? ""}' with high relevanceScore (~0.9), include it in getRelevantContext(); improve keyword matching to also match partial substrings (match a query token against longer content words both directions); add getContextSummary(question: string): string returning a human-readable multi-line summary (counts per chunk type + short preview). Keep the token-budget logic.
In src/ai/OpenAIProvider.ts update the system prompt to instruct the model to end each answer with a line formatted exactly 'Confidence: High' | 'Confidence: Medium' | 'Confidence: Low'.

In src/tabs/AITab.tsx: capture the context summary per assistant reply (extend the local message state with an optional contextSummary, or a parallel id->summary map populated from contextEngine.getContextSummary(question)); render a collapsible 'Context used' section above each assistant reply; regex-parse /Confidence:\s*(High|Medium|Low)/i from the reply content and show a colored Badge (green/amber/grey), nothing when absent; add a Copy button (accessibilityRole='button') per assistant message using Clipboard from 'react-native' with a safe no-op fallback. No new deps.

In src/index.ts add `export type { AppError } from './types/ErrorTypes';` and `export type { AppLensStorage } from './storage/AppLensStorage';`. Keep ALL existing exports (including AppLensUI as the UI component — do NOT rename to AppLensDebugUI). Confirm the required surface is present: AppLens, AppLensProvider, AppLensUI, AppLensConfig, NetworkRequest, LogEntry, LogLevel, AppEvent, AIMessage, AppError, AppLensStorage.
Run the full type-check and fix any errors introduced across the above steps.
acceptance_criteria: `cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens && npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 (previously failed with TS5095).
Files exist: src/types/ErrorTypes.ts, src/utils/redact.ts, src/interceptors/ErrorInterceptor.ts, src/tabs/ErrorsTab.tsx.
AppLensStorage declares addError/getErrors/clearErrors and MemoryStorage implements them synchronously; the subscribe listener container is Set<() => void>.
AppLens exposes getVersion() returning '0.2.0' and reset(); ErrorInterceptor is wired to initialize when config.errors !== false.
AppLensConfig has errors/persistLogs/verboseLogging/redaction fields with all existing fields intact; DEFAULT_CONFIG updated.
The modal shows 7 tabs with 'Errors' between 'Events' and 'AI'; all tab/close TouchableOpacity have accessibilityRole='button'; the ErrorsTab FlatList keyExtractor returns item.id.
OverviewTab shows an errors (total + fatal) row and an AppLens version row.
JSONViewer renders colored spans and scrolls horizontally while keeping its { data, maxHeight? } prop API.

ContextEngine.getRelevantContext includes AppError entries formatted '[ERROR] ${e.message}\n${e.stack ?? ""}' and getContextSummary exists; AITab shows a Context-used section, a Confidence badge, and a Copy button per assistant reply.
src/index.ts exports AppError and AppLensStorage and still exports every prior symbol.
No new entries were added to package.json dependencies/devDependencies.
verification: test -f src/types/ErrorTypes.ts && test -f src/utils/redact.ts && test -f src/interceptors/ErrorInterceptor.ts && test -f src/tabs/ErrorsTab.tsx
findings:
FEAT-001 complete. `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 (tsconfig moduleResolution now 'node'). package.json version bumped 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0; no new deps.

NEW FILES: src/types/ErrorTypes.ts, src/utils/redact.ts, src/interceptors/ErrorInterceptor.ts, src/tabs/ErrorsTab.tsx.

NEW TYPE: AppError { id: string; message: string; stack?: string; timestamp: number; isFatal: boolean } (src/types/ErrorTypes.ts).

redact utils (src/utils/redact.ts): redactHeaders(headers: Record<string, unknown>, sensitiveKeys: string[]): Record<string, unknown>; redactFields(obj: unknown, sensitiveFields: string[]): unknown. Replacement token is '[REDACTED]'. NetworkInterceptor now imports redactHeaders from this util (local copy removed; call sites cast result to Record<string,string>). Behaviour unchanged.

AppLensStorage interface + MemoryStorage: added synchronous addError(error: AppError): void; getErrors(query?: { limit?: number }): AppError[] (returns most-recent `limit` via slice(-limit) when set, else full copy); clearErrors(): void. MemoryStorage constructor gained a 4th param maxErrorEntries (default 200). Listener container stays Set<() => void>.

AppLensConfig NEW FIELDS (all existing fields intact): errors: boolean (DEFAULT true); persistLogs?: boolean (DEFAULT false, reserved/not implemented); verboseLogging?: boolean (DEFAULT false); redaction?: { headers?: string[]; fields?: string[] } (DEFAULT undefined). The existing header-redaction config field remains `redactHeaders: string[]` (defaulting to REDACTED_HEADERS) and is what NetworkInterceptor actually uses — the new `redaction` object is additive and currently unused by interceptors. DEFAULT_CONFIG updated.

AppLens core: added getVersion(): string returning '0.2.0'; added reset(): void (detaches all interceptors, clears network/logs/events/errors storage, sets initialized=false). ErrorInterceptor wired into startInterceptors() and attachInterceptors() when config.errors !== false, and detached in detachInterceptors(). ErrorInterceptor preserves RN's existing ErrorUtils global handler (calls it after capturing) and uses Hermes enablePromiseRejectionTracker when available for non-fatal rejection capture.

UI: AppLensProvider TabName union now includes 'Errors'; context value exposes `errors: AppError[]`. AppLensModal renders 7 tabs in order ['Overview','Network','Console','Events','Errors','AI','Settings'] (Errors between Events and AI); all tab TouchableOpacity + close button have accessibilityRole='button'. ErrorsTab: header count + Clear (AppLens.getStorage().clearErrors()), SearchBar on message, FlatList<AppError> keyExtractor=item.id, ListEmptyComponent, isFatal red/amber Badge, tap expands stack in a horizontal ScrollView. OverviewTab adds an 'Errors' section (Total + Fatal badges) and an 'AppLens' config row showing v${AppLens.getVersion()}.

JSONViewer: rewritten to render colored inline Text spans (keys #00ff88, string values #b8d7a3, numbers/booleans/null #f0a35e, punctuation #777) inside nested vertical+horizontal ScrollViews. Props unchanged: { data: unknown; maxHeight?: number } (default maxHeight 300).

AI: ContextEngine.getRelevantContext now includes error chunks (buildErrorChunks: storage.getErrors() recent-first, top 5, content '[ERROR] ${message}\n${stack ?? ""}', relevanceScore 0.9, emitted with ContextChunk type 'log' since the ContextChunk union has no 'error' member). Keyword matching improved to bidirectional partial-substring matching. Added getContextSummary(question: string): string (multi-line, counts + preview per chunk type). OpenAIProvider system prompt now instructs the model to end answers with a line exactly 'Confidence: High|Medium|Low'. AITab: parallel id->summary map (contextSummaries) populated from getContextSummary(question); each assistant bubble shows a collapsible 'Context used' section, a Confidence Badge parsed via /Confidence:\s*(High|Medium|Low)/i (green/amber/grey, hidden when absent), and a Copy button (accessibilityRole='button') using Clipboard from 'react-native' with a try/catch no-op fallback.

EXPORTS (src/index.ts) — all prior symbols kept; added `export type { AppError } from './types/ErrorTypes';` and `export type { AppLensStorage } from './storage/AppLensStorage';`. Confirmed surface: AppLens, AppLensProvider, useAppLens, AppLensUI (NOT renamed), AppLensModal, AppLensTrigger, AppLensConfig, NetworkRequest, LogEntry, LogLevel, AppEvent, AppError, AIMessage, AIConversation, ContextChunk, AppLensStorage, AIProvider, createAIProvider, OpenAIProvider, LocalAIProvider, KnowledgeGraph, GraphNode, NodeType, ContextEngine. Package name stays @applens/react-native.
